# Brand footer

Shared plate for every UC Lab HTML page. Other labs copy two files and paste the boot snippet below. PDF and slide work can copy the strings and SVG paths in this file. Do not fetch icons from a CDN.

## Files

- `shared/brand-footer.js` — disclaimer, copyright line, `LINKS` list, inline SVG paths, and the mount function.
- `shared/brand-footer.css` — the thin bordered panel. It reads the page theme tokens. No images and no network.

The UC Lab loads those files from `flagship/assets/site.js` (every flagship page and the repository root) and from `campus/assets/app.js` (the campus shell). `campus/index.html` stays a script-free refresh to the shell. That stub is the only HTML page without the plate.

Offline zips also carry `shared/brand-footer.js` and `shared/brand-footer.css` at the zip root. The boot tries `../../shared/` first (this repository) and `../shared/` second (a zip whose `assets/` folder sits at the root).

## Boot snippet

Paste this after your shell script, or call it while `document.currentScript` is that script. Paths are relative to the script file, not the HTML page.

```html
<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  if (window.__ucBrandFooterBoot) return;
  window.__ucBrandFooterBoot = true;
  var shell = document.currentScript && document.currentScript.src;
  if (!shell || !document.head) return;
  var list = ["../../shared/brand-footer.js", "../shared/brand-footer.js"];
  var index = 0;
  function load() {
    if (index >= list.length) return;
    var jsUrl = new URL(list[index], shell).href;
    index += 1;
    var link = document.createElement("link");
    link.rel = "stylesheet";
    link.href = new URL("brand-footer.css", jsUrl).href;
    document.head.appendChild(link);
    var script = document.createElement("script");
    script.src = jsUrl;
    script.onerror = function () {
      if (link.parentNode) link.parentNode.removeChild(link);
      load();
    };
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  }
  load();
})();
</script>
```

A page that already sits next to `shared/` can use a direct tag instead. The script mounts itself and loads the CSS if the link is missing.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="shared/brand-footer.css">
<script src="shared/brand-footer.js"></script>
```

## Panel copy

Disclaimer, plain text:

> Educational independent study project by a student. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Cisco or any vendor. Trademarks belong to their owners. Verify against official docs.

Name and copyright, one line:

> Cypher Monkey Labs © 2026 CypherMonkeyLabs 🐒

The word mark is `Cypher Monkey Labs`. The copyright run is `© 2026 CypherMonkeyLabs 🐒`.

## Active icons

Rendered only when `href` is an `https://` URL and `icon` matches a path below. Each control is a link with a visible text label and an accessible name (`aria-label`). The tap target is the whole link, at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels. The SVG is inline, `viewBox="0 0 24 24"`, `fill: currentColor`, `aria-hidden="true"`.

| Order | icon id | Visible label | Accessible name | URL |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `github` | GitHub | GitHub | https://github.com/cipher0x9 |
| 2 | `github` | Labs org | Labs org | https://github.com/CypherMonkeyLabs |
| 3 | `website` | Website | Website | https://cyphermonkeylabs.com |
| 4 | `x` | X | X | https://x.com/Cypher0x9 |
| 5 | `linkedin` | LinkedIn | LinkedIn | https://www.linkedin.com/in/luckylakshmanucwebex |
| 6 | `huggingface` | Hugging Face | Hugging Face | https://huggingface.co/Cypher0x9 |

GitHub is used twice. Personal GitHub and the Labs org share the `github` path and differ by label and URL.

There is no email address and no Linktree entry.

## Add a network in one line

Append one object to the `LINKS` array in `shared/brand-footer.js`. An empty `href` is not drawn. Instagram, Kaggle, and Google Developer stay in `ICONS` so the path is ready, and they are not in the published row.

```js
{ icon: "instagram", label: "Instagram", name: "Instagram", href: "https://..." },
{ icon: "kaggle", label: "Kaggle", name: "Kaggle", href: "https://..." },
{ icon: "google", label: "Google", name: "Google Developer", href: "https://..." }
```

## SVG paths

Brand marks for GitHub, X, LinkedIn, Hugging Face, Instagram, Kaggle, and Google are the simple-icons 13.15.0 paths (24×24, one filled path). Website has no simple-icons slug, so it uses a filled globe.

## Themes

The panel does not ship its own palette. It uses the page:

- Flagship (`html[data-theme]`): `neon`, `holographic`, `cyberpunk`, `sunset`, `light`. Tokens: `--a`, `--b`, `--c`, `--teal`, `--ink`, `--muted`, `--card`, `--line`.
- Campus: `light`, `dark`, `signal`, `contrast`. Tokens: `--teal`, `--purple`, `--gold`, `--ink`, `--muted`, `--card`, `--line`.

The top edge is a 2px gradient of those accents. High contrast (`data-theme="contrast"`) uses a 2px white border, black fill, and yellow icon links.

## Layout

- 390px: three columns. Labels wrap inside the cell. The page does not scroll sideways.
- 800px and up, including 1440px: six columns, row max-width 720px, still inside the page column.
- The plate is in normal flow at the end of `footer.site-foot` or `footer.studio-foot`, under the fixed menu and the bottom bar (`z-index` stays with the page).
- Print hides `.brand-footer`. Cheat-sheet print footers are unchanged.

## Do not add yet

- Instagram, Kaggle, and Google Developer until each URL is real.
- Email.
- Linktree.
